rca of the issue:
iter3 RCA: Greenhouse's board API returns the `content` field as HTML-ENTITY-ENCODED HTML (e.g. '<div><p>...</p></div>'). BeautifulSoup treats the entities as text data, decodes them to literal '

...

' characters, and returns them from get_text(). Fix (verified): the very first line of _html_to_plain now does `unescaped = html_lib.unescape(html or '')` and BeautifulSoup parses that, so the decoded entities become real DOM tags and get stripped by get_text(). Live evidence: curl POST /api/scrape-jd on the Discord Account Executive URL returns 4509 chars with 0 '<' characters (was 88+ in iter3).
